published_title: Biggest Twigg's Big Blue Mosh at Endor
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''twigg''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in November 2000.
description: This deck is a Big Blue deck based on the endor objective used to fight against Mains, Hidden base, and is fast.  Used by my Dad Biggest Twigg in Worlds 2k, went 3-1 for him.	Now improved after JPOSTD.
cards: posted: Something Special Planned for them
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting (8) as posted: the Objective, Endor, Endor: Landing Platform (posted 'EndorDB'), Endor: Bunker, 'starting inter for 3 effects' (dested Prepared Defenses, the only such Dark Interrupt in the pool), Imperial Arrest Order, Battle Order and You Cannot Hide Forever; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Running totals in the post reach 60 as published.

Posted 'Battle Plan' (a Light Effect) on this Dark list dested the Dark counterpart Battle Order (Death Star II Effect, not the later Defensive Shield). Posted '2 Signals' (The Signal is a Light Interrupt) dested the Dark Jabba's Palace counterpart Twi'lek Advisor (take an Effect into hand from Reserve Deck).

Posted 'New Age Executor' dested Flagship Executor (Death Star II), the newer of the two Executor cards. '3 Dreadnoughts' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Bosk In Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckass in mist Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Mon Cal' Mon Calamari; 'Omnious Rumors' Ominous Rumors.
Posted '2 Meerjek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Ad Piet' Admiral Piett; 'Ad Chinerau' Admiral Chiraneau; 'Off Evax' Officer Evax; 'Cpt Godhert' Captain Godherdt; 'Emperor' Emperor Palpatine.

The strategy's two 'Deck edit' notes (a Presence Of The Force or First Strike out for There Is No Try; Blast Door Controls in for the Emperor; First Strike out for There'll Be Hell To Pay) are not applied; the list is dested as posted.

Posted by Brian Terwilliger, who says the deck was used by his dad ('Biggest Twigg') at Worlds 2000 and went 3-1, then improved after Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck; credited to Brian as the poster, filed as general.
player_note: The post says: "Used by my Dad Biggest Twigg in Worlds 2k, went 3-1 for him. Now improved after JPOSTD." ([[2000 Decipher World Championship]]); this posted list is the improved version.
